# Source materials and licenses

The example source bodies from CPython, Blinker and Pluggy are unchanged exact selected files. Their pinned repository, version and hashes are in `contracts/MISSION.json`. They are inspected as data, not imported by the runner. Original license texts are retained here. CPython: Copyright (c) 2001-2024 Python Software Foundation; All Rights Reserved. No changes were made to its selected implementation.

Software Carpentry teaching material and the Repoformer paper landing-page abstract are represented by short summaries, not complete copies or implemented research models. The original links remain in the manifest. The study does not claim authorship of these methods or a general legal clearance.

`examples/sources/demo_jobs.py`, `mixed_snippet.txt`, `queue_fixture.js` and `instructions_not_authority.txt` are synthetic fixtures written for this project.
